Y'know, I sometimes get ribbed for all of the testing and fuckery I do trying different software & platforms, but with the way of things at the moment my screwaroundary has already paid dividends. 

Every day it seems like another trusted platform betrays us all by selling out, succumbing to AI psychosis, or any one of a number of decisions that make them no longer an acceptable choice. Of late, I read someone on here lamenting that the latest Mastodon update apparently broke compatibility with one of the BSDs.

One of the big (and hardest) lessons that I've learned over my half-century of circling this rather ordinary star out here in the suburbs of the Milky Way is: *always have a 'Plan B'*.

Also, it's kind of fun. 😀 

#SelfHost #SelfHosting #SelfHosted
